about.title: Independent, senior and accountable
about.body:
We started Northbeam in 2014 with a simple idea: small senior teams deliver better work than large junior ones.

Today we're 45 people across Mumbai and London. We work with a handful of clients at a time, so every engagement gets our full attention.
about.mission: Help organisations make better products with less risk.
about.vision: Be the partner companies call first when the work really matters.
